item.title: BAIC Opens In Cebu
item.description: BAIC Philippines officially opened its newest dealership in Cebu. Located along Gov. M. Cuenco Avenue corner J. Panis Street in Kasambagan, Cebu City, the dealership is operated by Pacific Autoworld, Inc., a part of the Borromeo Group. Read More »

item.title: Ford Philippines Aims To Keep Hybrid SUV Leadership With New Territory Hybrid Platinum. Yours For P 1.655M
item.description: Ford Philippines aims to solidify its lead as the country’s best-selling hybrid SUV with the launch of the new Territory Hybrid Platinum. The new variant sits atop the Titanium X bringing with it an elevated sense of style, added safety, and first-in-class luxury features. Read More »

item.title: Luxury in every sense
item.description: Lexus Philippines has introduced the eighth-generation ES with two hybrid variants and the nameplate’s first battery-electric model. Prices start at P4.108 million, with vehicle releases set to begin later in August.

item.title: The Jetour T2 Has Sold More Than 500,000 Units Globally
item.description: The Jetour T2 continues to gain ground around the world, hitting the 500,000-unit sales milestone globally only 33 months after its debut.
